get.description:
List all environments(endpoints) based on the current user authorizations. Will
return all environments(endpoints) if using an administrator or team leader account otherwise it will
only return authorized environments(endpoints).
**Access policy**: restricted

parameters.description: Start searching from
parameters.name: start

parameters.description: Limit results to this value
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description: Sort results by this value
parameters.name: sort

parameters.description: Order sorted results by desc/asc
parameters.name: order

parameters.description: If true, an `X-Update-Available` header will be added to the response to indicate if an update is available
parameters.name: updateInformation

parameters.description: If true, an `X-K8S-Env-Admin` header will be added to the response to indicate if the user is a K8S environment admin for any of the returned environments
parameters.name: k8sEnvAdmin

parameters.description: Search query
parameters.name: search

parameters.description: List environments(endpoints) of these groups
parameters.name: groupIds

parameters.description: List environments(endpoints) by this status
parameters.name: status

parameters.description: List environments(endpoints) of this type
parameters.name: types

parameters.description: Filter environments by platform type
parameters.name: platformTypes

parameters.description: If true, return only environments with an outdated agent
parameters.name: outdated

parameters.description: Exclude environments of these groups
parameters.name: excludeGroupIds

parameters.description: search environments(endpoints) with these tags (depends on tagsPartialMatch)
parameters.name: tagIds

parameters.description: If true, will return environment(endpoint) which has one of tagIds, if false (or missing) will return only environments(endpoints) that has all the tags
parameters.name: tagsPartialMatch

parameters.description: will return only these environments(endpoints)
parameters.name: endpointIds

parameters.description: will exclude these environments(endpoints)
parameters.name: excludeIds

parameters.description: If true, will return environment(endpoint) that were provisioned
parameters.name: provisioned

parameters.description: will return only environments with on of these agent versions
parameters.name: agentVersions

parameters.description: if exists true show only edge async agents, false show only standard edge agents. if missing, will show both types (relevant only for edge agents)
parameters.name: edgeAsync

parameters.description: if true, show only untrusted edge agents, if false show only trusted edge agents (relevant only for edge agents)
parameters.name: edgeDeviceUntrusted

parameters.description: if bigger then zero, show only edge agents that checked-in in the last provided seconds (relevant only for edge agents)
parameters.name: edgeCheckInPassedSeconds

parameters.description: if true, the snapshot data won't be retrieved
parameters.name: excludeSnapshots

parameters.description: will return only environments(endpoints) with this name
parameters.name: name

parameters.description: Filter environments by partial name match (case-insensitive, searches name only)
parameters.name: nameFilter

parameters.description: will return the environments of the specified edge stack
parameters.name: edgeStackId

parameters.description: only applied when edgeStackId exists. Filter the returned environments based on their deployment status in the stack (not the environment status!)
parameters.name: edgeStackStatus

parameters.description: List environments(endpoints) of these edge groups
parameters.name: edgeGroupIds

parameters.description: Exclude environments(endpoints) of these edge groups
parameters.name: excludeEdgeGroupIds

parameters.description: If true, will apply policy data to the returned environments(endpoints)
parameters.name: policy

parameters.description: List environments(endpoints) associated with these policies
parameters.name: policyIds

parameters.description: Filter environments by policy status (applied, failed, in_progress, warning, not_supported). Only applies when policyIds is specified.
parameters.name: policyStatus
